worktree.note: Work happens in a git worktree beside the main checkout; briefs and handoffs were copied in, tmp/codex-main is a symlink to the main checkout's reference source.

package.name: @buyong/pi-codex-computer-use
package.build: tsc via `npm run build` (Turborepo), formatting/lint via `npm run check` (Biome, 4-space indent)
package.noAutoReviewDependency: grep -r pi-codex-auto-review packages/pi-codex-computer-use/dist → no matches; packages/pi-codex-auto-review has no diff

modules.src/index.ts: default export factory: resolves the settings path, loads settings on session_start (reports invalid files, mirrors to stderr without UI), sets the footer status `codex-cua: computer on · browser on`, registers /codex-computer-use. Starts no process. Re-exports every public symbol below.
modules.src/settings.ts: FeatureState {computerUse, browserUse}, DEFAULT_FEATURE_STATE (true/true), DISABLED_FEATURE_STATE, validateFeatureState (exactly two boolean keys, unknown keys rejected), FeatureSettingsStore.load() → SettingsLoadResult {source: defaults|file|invalid, state, error?}, FeatureSettingsStore.save() (mkdir 0o700, temp file + rename, mode 0o600), describeFeatureState.
modules.src/platform.ts: detectPlatform(env, hostPlatform) → PlatformInfo (darwin verified, win32 unverified, others unsupported; PI_CODEX_COMPUTER_USE_PLATFORM override sets isSimulated when it differs from the host), resolveCodexHome (CODEX_HOME, else USERPROFILE/.codex on real win32, else ~/.codex), describePlatform.
modules.src/runtime.ts: discoverRuntime({env, platform}) → RuntimePlan | RuntimeUnavailable; locateServiceApp (SKY_CUA_SERVICE_PATH → $CODEX_HOME/computer-use → @oai/sky copy); readRuntimeManifest; readBundleInfo (plutil); describeRuntime; constants CUA_REPL_SERVER_NAME, SURFACES_VARIABLE, TRUSTED_SERVICES_VARIABLE, SERVICE_APP_PATH_VARIABLE, CODEX_DESKTOP_BUNDLE_ID, SERVICE_APP_NAME, pluginCacheDir.
modules.src/install.ts: checkPrerequisites({env, runSetupScript, setupTimeoutMs}) → PrerequisiteReport {platform, runtime, checks[], setupScript?, piVersion}; formatPrerequisiteReport → string[]. Runs Codex's setup script and the package's own runtime validation; everything else is read-only.
modules.src/commands.ts: registerCodexComputerUseCommand(pi, {settingsPath, getSettings, updateState, describeServer}); COMMAND_NAME, COMMAND_USAGE; argument completions; `report()` mirrors notify text to stderr when ctx.hasUI is false.

settings.path: <agentDir>/codex-computer-use/settings.json where agentDir = getAgentDir() from pi (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, else ~/.pi/agent)
settings.missingFile: defaults, nothing is written until the first toggle
settings.invalidFile: reported on session_start and by every command; both features treated as off for the session; toggles are refused with the error so the file is never overwritten silently
settings.write: atomic temp file + rename, directory 0o700, file 0o600, pretty JSON with the two keys only

discovery: app-bundle fallback (/Applications/ChatGPT.app, ~/Applications/ChatGPT.app, /Applications/Codex.app, ~/Applications/Codex.app, or PI_CODEX_COMPUTER_USE_APP_PATH; bundle id com.openai.codex checked through plutil)
darwin.serviceCheck: locateServiceApp order SKY_CUA_SERVICE_PATH → $CODEX_HOME/computer-use/Codex Computer Use.app → <node_modules>/@oai/sky/Codex Computer Use.app

discovery: plugin-cache only (CODEX_HOME, else %USERPROFILE%\.codex); no app-bundle fallback → RuntimeUnavailable plugin-cache-missing with guidance to enable Computer Use once in Codex Desktop
win32.serviceCheck: <node_modules>/@oai/sky/bin/windows/codex-computer-use(-arm64).exe presence (the Windows target in @oai/sky spawns this helper; no separate service app) → reported as unverified when present
win32.gap: Never executed on a Windows machine; only the simulated plugin-cache path was exercised from this Mac (see verification.simulated).

linux.behavior: platform-unsupported without touching the filesystem; Codex Desktop has no Linux Computer Use configuration (codex-rs/config/src/computer_use.rs)

shape.env: Record<string,string> — verbatim from .mcp.json (includes CUA_REPL_ENABLED_SURFACES and NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_SERVICES, which 03-mcp-bridge overrides) or composed from the app bundle (those two keys absent)

discoveryOrder: newest enabled .mcp.json whose command exists (existence skipped when simulated)
macOS: app bundle candidates → manifest.json → compose env with the same keys Codex Desktop writes

overrideVariables.CODEX_HOME: Codex state directory (also Codex's own variable)

thisMac.fallbackComparison: With an empty CODEX_HOME the app-bundle plan has the same command, args and env keys minus CUA_REPL_ENABLED_SURFACES and NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_SERVICES; values differ only where CODEX_HOME is embedded (CODEX_HOME, NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_CODE_PATHS) and SKY_CUA_SERVICE_PATH points at the copy inside @oai/sky.

findings: Codex's cua_node/bin/setup.sh (and setup.ps1) assert npm/npx launchers that the 26.930.31730 macOS build does not ship, so the script fails on a working install. The package reports this as unverified and runs its own equivalent validation (node version vs manifest, @oai/sky import, node_repl --help).
pi 0.99.1 implements ExtensionUIContext.notify as a no-op in print/JSON modes; commands mirror their output to stderr when ctx.hasUI is false.
The Windows sky target has no separate service app: it spawns @oai/sky/bin/windows/codex-computer-use(-arm64).exe with --parent-pid; the Windows service check therefore looks for that helper.
Codex resolves CODEX_HOME as the env var when non-empty, else ~/.codex (codex-rs/utils/home-dir); the Windows helper transport additionally uses %USERPROFILE%\.codex.
unresolved: Windows: implemented but never executed on a Windows machine (discovery, setup.ps1 invocation, helper exe check, registry check).
App-bundle fallback sets SKY_CUA_SERVICE_PATH to the copy inside @oai/sky when ~/.codex/computer-use is absent; whether that copy launches from pi is for 01-feasibility to prove.
TUI rendering of the select menu and footer status was not driven automatically.
The global pi 1.0.2 was only smoke-tested in print mode; the package is built against 0.99.1 types.
